mentions.name: Kolibri
mentions.description: This effort adds new openly licensed learning resources to the Kolibri offline learning platform, which is designed to be deployed in communities without consistent public internet access. It also aims to lead translation efforts to bring the best available materials into the dozens of non-English languages the core software already supports.
mentions.problem: The platform has a significant amount of English language content but is limited in what is available in the dozens of other languages into which the core software has been translated.
mentions.audience: Communities that lack consistent access to the public internet, who currently have plenty of English content but limited material in the many other languages the platform supports
mentions.source_excerpt: Adding new openly licensed learning resources to the Kolibri offline learning platform. It is designed to be deployed in communities that lack consistent access to the public internet. They currently have a significant amount of English language content, but are limited in what they have available in the dozens of other languages they have translated the core software into. I'm trying to bring in new resources and then try to lead an effort to do translations of the best materials I can find to make the platform more useful to more people.
